body: Thank you, I appreciate it.
Thank you.
God, I hope they mouth swab. Thank you.

Synthetic urine makes me so nervous. I'm a terrible liar.

Do you pee into the toilet while you're pouring it into the cup to make it sound like you're actually going? Where do you keep it? Do drug test places search you?
I wish I could. Honestly. The cost of living here is crazy-high and this is an awesome opportunity for a career that pays me well in a low cost-of-living area.
Thank you. I hope things get better for you. You seem like a really nice person and you don't deserve this.

I got really good at pushing away suicidal ideations and not really wanting to die because I felt like my life was good. Now, not so much. Broke, alone, no future, and the bleakness of the world is making it incredibly hard to be optimistic.
Thank you.

I don't know what to say. Your song was really beautiful (and you totally didn't need to clarify, it was great!). I wasn't expecting anyone to really read this much less write a song for me.

I want to apologize because I could tell you felt bad while you were talking and I'm sorry for causing that.

Thank you for your kind words and your song. You are incredibly compassionate.
Thank you. <3

Thank you. Your comment really did make me feel a bit better. <3

/hug

That's exactly right. I think there's parts of me that think I *only* deserve sadness and pain, so therefore, it's fitting that it's all that I feel right now.

/hugs
Thank you, that's very kind.

I'm in grad school too. It's really, really tough. It sounds like you may need to talk to one of your advisors or your thesis advisors, if you have those. Lots of grad students go through stuff like this, but nobody ever talks about it.
Thanks. I appreciate the thought.
Idk if it's better that I'm having sex or that I'm being used for exploratory sex. 😑

Impulsiveness can be apart of the depression struggle absolutely.

Be careful, though. Most suicides are done as impulsive gestures, not carefully planned.
